content: Tab labels live in the TABS array in telemetry.tsx while the child route path stays stable for deep links (DELIVERY tab serves /telemetry/loop). TelemetryWindow threads projectId through telemetryAnalyticsFilter/telemetryQueryKey in telemetry-window.helpers.ts (a pure module so bun test resolves it without the @/ alias — UI unit tests must use relative imports) into the /analytics/runs and /analytics/behavior query keys and calls; the project <select> sits beside RangeSelector in telemetry.tsx.

name: economics-panels-wire-derivation
description: warren-cc6c: economics tab side panels (economics-panels.tsx) derive everything from /analytics/cost breakdowns + /analytics/runs tokens/outcomes with honest empty states; helpers in economics-helpers.ts are the testable unit. Non-test UI modules must use relative imports, not the @/ alias, or bun test from repo root fails to resolve (judge-verdicts.ts precedent).
